answer: Because the timing is recorded against the karst challenge, the prism audit can replay the ledge history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 267 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2200 identities would post 2946 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
